title: I started from a place of embracing that which I cannot control
description: Presented by Patricia Sweetow Gallery, this solo exhibition brought together a series of monumental sculptural tapestries exploring landscape, memory, and the tensions between control and uncertainty. Drawing from the visual language of the Hudson River School, I use industrial cordage and intricate weaving techniques to reinterpret idealized representations of the American landscape. Created during a period of social and political uncertainty, these works explore the relationship between material, history, and identity, transforming familiar landscapes into tactile environments that challenge traditional boundaries between painting and sculpture.
